description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class 'Coocook::Controller::ShopSection' responsible for managing shop sections within a project. It includes actions for listing, creating, updating, and deleting shop sections, with associated URL routing and permission checks.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::ShopSection
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing shop sections within a project.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all shop sections, including URLs for updating and deleting each section.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new shop section, with validation for duplicate names.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained method to load a specific shop section by ID, or detach with not_found error.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the name of an existing shop section.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a shop section if it is deletable.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to redirect to the index action.
